status: Conditional calibrated component model, not an observed factory-capacity census

provenance.opening_stock: Approximate inherited Epoch baseline; see first report. Not a synchronized operational-stock measurement.
provenance.fp8_pf_fp16_pf: Vendor specs C04-C07 in report; sparse Nvidia H100/B300 numbers divided by two, Rubin explicitly dense.
provenance.hbm_gb: Vendor nominal capacities, TPU 192 GiB converted to decimal GB. B300 288 GB proxy assumption consistent with product family; rack specification is rounded 20 TB.
provenance.logic_mm2: H100/B300 proxy areas carried from original model; TPU and Rubin chosen assumptions, NOT verified die measurements.
provenance.packaging_units: All chosen relative resource burdens; NOT measured interposer areas or foundry wafer equivalents.
provenance.baseline_mix_end_mix: All chosen package-count proxy mixtures, NOT vendor shipment forecasts. Other vendors represented by these hardware classes.
provenance.logic_growth: Assumed annual growth in AI-allocated usable good silicon area; includes capacity, allocation, yields. No independently measured factory count.
provenance.packaging_growth: Assumed annual growth in usable packaging resources. Central 1.6 informed by C03, whose over-60%-by-2027 statement does NOT establish a 2026-to-2027 annual rate.
provenance.dram_bit_growth: Assumed annual total DRAM bit growth. HBM usable bits grow by this times 13/9 from C02. Ratio mapped to a constant annual trajectory from Q2 2026, an assumption.
provenance.extra_hbm_fraction: Additional memory burden beyond hardware table, linearly phased by end-2027; assumption.
provenance.lag_annual_retirement: Chosen scenarios; lag=1 informed by Epoch deployment methodology. No independently enforced power cap.
